# Frets

> Frets (https://frets.eminor.net) is a guitar fretboard app: scales,
> chords, triads, the circle of fifths, a tuner, a metronome, a tab editor
> and ear trainers. Agents can write chords and tab that open in it from a
> link, and show its metronome in a chat through an MCP server.

People: see https://frets.eminor.net/agents for these skills to download
and the connector to add.

## Guides

- [Chord links](https://frets.eminor.net/chord-links.txt): open a chord or a chord shape on the Chords page
- [Tab as alphaTex](https://frets.eminor.net/tab-alphatex.txt): write tab the Tab page opens, and link to it
- [Tab as ASCII](https://frets.eminor.net/tab-ascii.txt): the plainer format the Tab page also reads

## Skills

- [frets-chords](https://frets.eminor.net/skills/frets-chords/SKILL.md): Agent Skill for chord links
- [frets-tab](https://frets.eminor.net/skills/frets-tab/SKILL.md): Agent Skill for tab

## MCP servers

- [Metronome](https://frets.eminor.net/mcp): a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in) with one tool, `show_metronome`, which shows a playable metronome in the chat as an MCP App, loaded with a tempo, beats, grouping, subdivision and swing
